subject: Acero Health — SOC 2 attestation binder & log onramp for renewal
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acerohealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acerohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert — questions & preferred evidence format

Kimberly,

As Acero’s renewal window opens next month we’re kicking off our recertification and have a few requests so we can keep the renewal on our Q2 board. High level: we need a compact attestation deliverable we can already hand to our internal audit + Procurement team. Can you provide the format and an initial list of artifacts you’ll deliver? Specifically:

- Confirm latest SOC 2 scope (prod-only vs prod+staging).
- Which logs / retention windows you can commit to for the audit window (we need both application and auth logs).
- A manifest/CSV of sample evidence items and who on Redwood will own each upload.

We’d prefer a single PDF “attestation binder” for our auditors, plus a CSV manifest. Also let us know if there are any capacity implications — Acero is planning a 15% seat increase if the retention window can be extended to 365 days.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Senior IT Audit Manager
Acero Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acerohealth.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acerohealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert — questions & preferred evidence format

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front and then an action list: 

- Scope: production services only (we can include staging artifacts if you want; that adds parallel evidence but is optional).
- Logs: we can commit application request logs, auth success/failure, and admin audit trails for the 365-day retention on the base Dedicated plan; for hosted plans we typically do 90 days by default.
- Deliverables: we’ll produce a one-file attestation binder (PDF) + evidence manifest CSV.

Attachments: I’m sending an initial attestation-binder-v1.pdf and a draft log-retention-onramp-matrix.xlsx so your audit team can see tradeoffs. Rishi (cc’d) will follow up on the onramp schedule and any capacity uplift quote for the 365-day retention.

Action items:
1) Rishi to confirm cost/seat delta for 365d retention and burst/storage impact.
2) We’ll prepare an evidence-manifest CSV mapping artifacts to S3 locations.
3) Confirm whether you want staging included.

I’ll loop in Lauren and Vanessa for pricing/contract language if we need a term amendment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: attestation-binder-v1.pdf (PDF, 2.1 MB); log-retention-onramp-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acero Health — retention ask (365d) / capacity impact

Kim / Lauren — quick calc for the sales thread: 365-day retention for their account at current ingestion (~120GB/day) increases annual storage delta ~44TB. We can absorb short-term but for sustained retention we should offer a priced onramp:

- Option A (Commit): 365d retention, +15% seats included, +$6k/month (storage + infra buffer).
- Option B (Burst & archive): 90d hot + 275d cold archive accessible on 24-48h retrieval SLA, +$3.2k/month.

If Acero confirms the +15% seat uplift (they mentioned it in their renewal sig), Option A maps cleanly to a term amendment. If they want to avoid term commitments, Option B is lower cost but requires an SLA note on retrieval.

I’ll draft language for the amendment; Lauren can you weigh in on how to frame the pricing change in the renewal? Vanessa, can you prepare a short statement for the renewal deck that explains the tradeoffs in 1 slide?

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acerohealth.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acerohealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, AuditLane <auditlane@auditors.co>
Date: Sat, 4 May 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert — questions & preferred evidence format

Sofia — attaching the requested materials and a short proposal so procurement can review options in one pass. Key points below, and I’ve attached an evidence-manifest-ACERO.csv that maps items we’ll upload to your audit folder.

- Scope: production only (we flagged which staging artifacts are available if you prefer).
- Attestation binder: single PDF (signed SOC 2 cover page + control narratives + sample evidence links).
- Retention options: Option A = 365d retention (term amendment + seat uplift option), Option B = hybrid 90d hot / archive 275d (no term change).
- Timeline: we can finish the bundle and manifest within 5 business days after you confirm desired retention option.

Please confirm if ProcureOps needs a draft redline for the amendment; we can provide a short-term amendment that amends Section 4 (Data Retention) and Section 9 (Fees).

Next step requests for Acero to confirm by EOD 2028-05-09 so we can hit your renewal date.

Cheers,
Kimberly

Attachments: evidence-manifest-ACERO.csv (CSV, 3 KB)

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acerohealth.com>

Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@acerohealth.com>

Kimberly / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the binder. Acero’s audit committee reviewed Option A and we’re ready to proceed with the 365-day retention and the +15% seats. A few items before we sign: 

1) Can you add a short note in the amendment that retention 365d includes admin audit trails and auth logs?
2) Please confirm expected delivery date for the full signed binder and manifest (we need to file with internal audit by 2028-05-16).
3) Procurement will need the amendment redline to route for approval — please send the DocuSign when ready.

If you can confirm those three items I’ll instruct ProcureOps to accept the Terms and queue contracts for signature.

Appreciate the clear options — Sofia
Sofia Ramos

Acero Health
